parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for planning and running our flights, which includes deciding which drone flies along which way and signing off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and I plan flights at the same time as other dispatchers, often for the same busy sites and popular drones. Our company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, but I do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts.
